_comment: The Person entity, in one place. seo.js emits this into every page so the
same identifiers are asserted 35+ times instead of once -- that repetition,
plus reciprocal links from each profile back here, is what lets a search or
answer engine merge 'Anuj Sadani' into a single entity.
identifier.* are null until registered. Nulls are skipped, never emitted --
a placeholder ID would be a false claim and worse than an absent one.
Fill them in and re-run `node scripts/seo.js`; nothing else needs to change.
Priority order for filling these: orcid (merges arXiv/SSRN/Zenodo/OpenAlex),
then wikidata (feeds Google's Knowledge Graph and LLM training data), then
name: Anuj Sadani
description: Anuj Sadani is a Principal Software Development Engineer at Infrrd in Pune, India. He builds enterprise generative-AI systems -- RAG platforms, agentic workflows, and evaluation pipelines -- leads the engineers who build them, and owns the organisation-wide Python stack. He writes about AI engineering, infrastructure, and security, and is the author of The Clean Vibe Coder.
_sameAs_comment: Pages that REPRESENT the person, not pages that mention him. A book's
product page is not sameAs its author -- an Amazon Author Central page
would be, which is why amazonAuthor sits in identifier above instead.
https://arxiv.org/a/sadani_a_1 was checked and 404s: arXiv author pages
must be claimed before they exist. Register it, then move it here.
